name: Pigment yellow 14
description: Pigment Yellow 14 (CAS 5468-75-7 ), also known commercially as Benzidine Yellow G and Permanent Yellow G, is a disazo organic pigment delivering a clean, greenish-yellow hue across a broad range of industrial colorant applications. It is valued for its strong tinting strength and cost-effective performance in high-volume manufacturing processes. In coatings and industrial paints, it is used to achieve bright yellow shades in architectural and automotive refinish formulations. General industrial formulations also benefit from its vibrant color profile. Printing ink manufacturers rely on it for offset, flexographic, and gravure inks used in packaging and commercial print runs where high visibility is required. Plastics compounders incorporate it into polyolefins and PVC to produce colored films, sheets, and molded components. Textile and paper applications use it as a colorant in surface coatings and pigment printing pastes for consistent results. Consistent batch-to-batch hue is a key procurement requirement for large scale operations. The material is supplied as a dry powder, typically in press cake or flushed paste form for ink and coating applications. Standard grades are available for plastics, printing inks, and general industrial use. Specifications are aligned to conventional organic pigment quality benchmarks to ensure performance across various manufacturing environments. Packaging is commonly offered in fiber drums or multi-wall bags suited to bulk industrial procurement.
